rules.politics: Exact ruling_party slot plus incumbent leader where required, checked at start AND completion. Coalition membership alone never unlocks an incumbent programme.

rules.buildings: Require owned and controlled intended state and room for the stated building; no silent alternative recipient. Conditions visible. Commit price and grant atomically; a full state prevents the focus from starting/completing.
rules.offers: Offer dispatch is not acceptance. Recipient may accept/refuse. No material agreement bonus or payment before acceptance; finite pending time, both-party revalidation and once-only signature required.
rules.gates: No universal year locks. Actual party office, constitutional settlement, research/project stage, peace and signed agreements supply meaningful gates.
rules.focus_time: Short administrative entries 14/21d, normal programmes 35d; paid construction and major constitutions 49/70d assigned explicitly in final catalogue.

anti_duplication: One active signature per contract, recipient pair and term. Offers reached via DRP/RPR/Roh/common tree share the same contract ledger.
Counterpart initiation from NKO resolves the same inter-Korean signature. Simultaneous offers lock to one pending transaction.
A paid focus with an offer stages its displayed budget; where the contract itself carries the same establishment payment it is charged only once on acceptance, not on dispatch as well.
Programme modifiers use owner+qualified policy slot. Completing a later level replaces that slot; it never stacks both levels.
Confederal focus entry AND completion require actual COLDWAR_KOR_confederal_member spirit on both sides; founding offer precedes membership.
Monthly/leadership/load sync recomputes active slot values and weekly costs only. Receipt flags protect all treasury, buildings, experience and PP.

party_guarantees.design: Set civilian-party-settlement receipt and keep competitive-party rights in native politics; numerical benefit and cost are the associated focus policy, with no hidden grant.

Enable guards are a second safeguard; the hook must detect exact-party changes within the same broad outlook.
